name: io.github.cyanheads/unhcr-refugees-mcp-server
description: Query UNHCR refugee, IDP, and stateless populations, asylum decisions, returns, and resettlement.

environmentVariables.name: UNHCR_REQUESTS_PER_SECOND
environmentVariables.description: Upstream request starts per second for the whole process (1–10).

environmentVariables.name: UNHCR_MAX_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Most upstream rows one tool call fetches (10000–500000); a larger result stops at the cap with complete: false.

environmentVariables.name: UNHCR_CACHE_MAX_MB
environmentVariables.description: Response-cache budget in MB; 0 disables the cache.

environmentVariables.name: UNHCR_DATASET_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Per-table TTL for staged dataframes, in seconds (minimum 60).

environmentVariables.name: UNHCR_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register unhcr_dataframe_drop; off by default, the per-table TTL reclaims staged tables.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: UNHCR_REQUESTS_PER_SECOND
environmentVariables.description: Upstream request starts per second for the whole process (1–10). Every caller of a hosted instance shares it.

environmentVariables.description: Most upstream rows one tool call fetches (10000–500000); a larger result stops at the cap with complete: false.

environmentVariables.name: UNHCR_DATASET_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Per-table TTL for staged dataframes, in seconds (minimum 60).

environmentVariables.name: UNHCR_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register unhcr_dataframe_drop; off by default, the per-table TTL reclaims staged tables.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
